children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is required to complete the design of{br}{br}All the Sub-Contractors Works{br}{br}Or{br}{br}Part of the Sub-Contractors Works as listed below:{br}{br}{br}Or{br}{br}There is no design responsibility{br}{br}The subcontractor is to adopt, validate and warrant the design carried out to date.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall refer to the Subcontractor design deliverables includded within the documentation for clarification of the key responsibilities and design deliverables required during the subcontractor design works.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall be responsible for the production of detailed design working drawings in accordance with the subcontractor design works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractors working detailed drawings shall reflect the design intentions, particularly dimensional configurations, profiles and visible appearances indicated on the design team's drawings and specifications.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall also refer to all relevant design team drawings and specifications, which provide further detailed requirements for the completion of the design by the subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall be responsible for the co-ordination of their subcontractor design works with the design of work carried out by any other subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall be responsible for ensuring the working detailed design is compliant with all statutory requirements including building regulations and associated standards and codes.

children.name: text
children: In addition to detailed design drawings produced by the Subcontractor, the Subcontractor shall also provide fabrication drawings in connection with non-CDP works, which show the interpretation of the client teams design for fabrication.

children.name: text
children: Fabrication drawings shall be provided by the Subcontractor as considered necessary by the Contractor to demonstrate the safe installation and co-ordination of the works.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor is to supply all samples and mock ups as required in the contract documents.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor detailed drawings, schedules & calculations are to conform with the Main Contract architectural, structural, and M&E specifications.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall provide detailed product information and collaborate with the Contractors Designers to ensure that any planning conditions and building regulations are met.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall allow for attendance to Design Team Meetings and other meetings as required.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be responsible for liaising directly with other Subcontractors and determining requirements for the co-ordination of the design, and carrying out such co-ordination, subject to the agreement of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The key interfaces within this package are as follows:

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor shall refer to the BREEAM requirements included within the documentation and ensure that they carry out their works and provide all necessary information in accordance with the requirements given to reach the credits stated.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor must include for the provision of the necessary resources to ensure compliance with the Contractors Information Protocol and that all information is issued in good time onto McLaren’s CDE and co-ordinate/respond to any comments accordingly.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor must include for the provision of all Subcontractor design information, method statements and technical information as requested to form part of the H&S File. This must be submitted in draft a minimum of 8 weeks prior to Practical Completion, for comment.

children: {b:Working drawings}: Showing a fully co-ordinated design with plans, sections and schematics confirming final service routes and plant location ensuring special co-ordination.

children.name: text
